288:t_1:3.en: ～ $$トップレス$$ $$タイタン$$ Base: $$サーペンタイン姉妹$$' Room ～

288:t_1:4.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「...The data $$ニコラス・バセロン$$ sent us is quite interesting.」

288:t_1:5.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「Yes. It was worth sending him into $c.」

288:t_1:6.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「But we meant to have him examine a parallel world's $$バスターマシン$$ and bring back data on that world's $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$...」

288:t_1:7.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「I never expected him to leap out of the solar system, go to the center of the galaxy, and fight there.」

288:t_1:8.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「It seems that thing is less a $$トップレス$$ from another planet than a space monster from a parallel world.」

288:t_1:9.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「Thanks to his data, we can now see our way to the revival.」

288:t_1:10.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「All that's left is to finish the preparations.」

288:t_1:11.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「When that thing awakens and we receive its power...」

288:t_1:14.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「Now then, shall we have dinner?」

288:t_1:15.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「$$タイタン$$ crab... I'm getting tired of this, too.」

288:t_1:16.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「Don't worry. Some different ingredients will be arriving soon, I'm sure.」

288:t_1:17.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「By the way, where is $c now?」

288:t_1:18.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「I believe they should be reaching Mars about now.」

288:t_1:20.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「Let's eat, praying for our future.」

288:t_2:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Then you have learned Prince $$ユーサー$$'s true intentions.」

288:t_2:5.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Yes. Once the settlement of Mars by the people of $$インサラウム$$ reached a lull, Commander $$マルグリット$$ had something to tell us.」

288:t_2:6.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「When we learned that we had pushed all the blame for the war onto the Prince, we were so consumed by guilt that all of us who had been knights considered taking our own lives.」

288:t_2:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Wait! If you did that, everything $$ユーサー・インサラウム$$ did would be for nothing!」

288:t_2:8.en:
$$赤木$$
「Then the Prince would've died for nothing!」

288:t_2:9.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Commander $$マルグリット$$ said the same thing you're saying now.」

288:t_2:10.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「So we cast aside the name and pride of knights, and decided to live on the soil of this Mars together with the people of $$インサラウム$$, even if it means living in shame.」

288:t_2:11.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We also apologize to you deeply for what happened back then.」

288:t_2:13.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「You have already made your amends. You must never stop repenting the past, but for now, let us walk on toward the future together.」

288:t_2:15.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「At the same time, on behalf of our people, allow us to thank you for your condolences for our Prince.」

288:t_2:16.en:
$$青山$$
「...By the way, isn't $$マルグリット$$, the leader of the settlers, here on Mars?」

288:t_2:17.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「The Commander should be on Earth right now.」

288:t_2:18.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...Should be...? Haven't you heard from her?」

288:t_2:20.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「But we believe the Commander is safe. She is the last $$ハイナイト$$, the one who kept our hopes alive.」

288:t_2:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Then allow me to get down to business. We'd like you to tell us what you know about the current state of $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

288:t_2:22.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「...While advancing the terraforming, we were also surveying this Mars, which was reconstructed by the $$新世時空震動$$.」

288:t_2:23.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「And then, when a new fusion of worlds occurred due to the destruction of the $$時の牢獄$$, a new enemy appeared on this Mars as well.」

288:t_2:24.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is it a different organization from the $$サイデリアル$$?」

288:t_2:25.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Yes. They were a group of Earthling origin.」

288:t_2:26.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「While Earth was under attack by the $$サイデリアル$$, we were fighting that enemy here as well.」

288:t_2:27.en:
$$勝平$$
「Wow! You guys had it rough too!」

288:t_2:28.en:
$$甲児$$
「What happened in the fight against that enemy?」

288:t_2:29.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Well... we were locked in a standoff, but somebody destroyed the enemy's home base, and the fighting ended.」

288:t_2:31.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「The battle took place inside a magnetic storm, so we don't know the details.」

288:t_2:32.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That enemy called themselves 《$$メガノイド$$》. Does that ring a bell?」

288:t_2:34.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I've never heard of it...」

288:t_2:35.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「At almost the same time those $$メガノイド$$ were wiped out, a gap in our surveillance was exploited and $$ＺＯＮＥ$$'s seal was broken.」

288:t_2:36.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Does it have something to do with whoever took down the $$メガノイド$$?」

288:t_2:37.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That is unknown. The garrison only saw a black machine flying away from $$ＺＯＮＥ$$... the $$シュロウガ$$.」

288:t_2:38.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We reported this matter to the $$地球連邦$$ right away, but...」

288:t_2:39.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「So the Federation wasn't in a position to concern itself with the situation on Mars, either...」

288:t_2:40.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Well, we had our hands full dealing with the $$サイデリアル$$ on our side.」

288:t_2:41.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Unable to stand by any longer, Commander $$マルグリット$$ left for Earth herself as a $$メッセンジャー$$.」

288:t_2:42.en:
$$キラ$$
「So we just missed each other...」

288:t_2:43.en:
$$セツコ$$
「In that case, we would like to investigate $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ ourselves.」

288:t_2:44.en:
$$ランド$$
「Right. Since we're the ones who slammed that guy into it, we've got to handle the after-sales service, too.」

288:t_2:45.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Would that be all right with everyone from $$インサラウム$$?」

288:t_2:46.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Understood. Leave supplies and the other arrangements to us.」

288:t_2:47.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ is also the mortal enemy of $$ジ・インサー$$, the treasure of $$インサラウム$$, and of His Highness.」

288:t_2:48.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We are in no position to ask this of you, but the late Prince's bitter regret...」

288:t_2:49.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I promise we will do our best.」

288:t_2:50.en:
$$ランド$$
($$ユーサー$$... The people you loved still love you to this day.)

288:t_2:51.en:
$$セツコ$$
(We will fight $$アサキム$$. For myself, for the people precious to me, and for you and your people, too...)

288:t_2:58.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I never expected anyone to be here.」

288:t_2:60.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...I came to see what a final end looks like.」

288:t_2:61.en:
???
「The end of the $$メガノイド$$...? No... the $$クロノ$$ Reformists'?」

288:t_2:63.en:
???
「...Those who exist across many parallel worlds and have ruled history from the shadows in the name of watching over humanity's evolution... $$クロノ$$...」

288:t_2:64.en:
???
「But from within that $$クロノ$$, defectors calling themselves the Reformists appeared.」

288:t_2:66.en:
???
「One of them, $$破嵐創造$$, sought to accelerate evolution artificially and created the $$メガノイド$$, a new humanity with the will within humans... that is, the ego... strengthened.」

288:t_2:67.en:
???
「By sacrificing his own wife and son.」

ジ・インサー.evidence: Bare form of glossary robot 聖王機ジ・インサー (Seiohki The Insa); called the treasure of Insaraum in this slice.
